paper.title_en: Optimal all-angle reconstruction of the Hellings-Downs curve
paper.abstract_en: Pulsar timing arrays (PTAs) detect nanohertz gravitational waves through spatial correlations between the timing residuals of different pulsars. For an isotropic, unpolarized stochastic background in general relativity, the ensemble-mean correlation follows the Hellings--Downs (HD) curve; measuring this angular pattern tests the gravitational-wave origin of the signal. Standard bin-by-bin reconstructions optimize the weights within each angular bin separately. We reconstruct the curve jointly using the full pulsar-pair covariance, retaining a free amplitude in every bin. The resulting all-angle best linear unbiased estimator minimizes the variance of every bin value and every linear combination of bins. Applied to the public NANOGrav 15 yr data products, our method reduces the bin standard deviations by up to 12.9\%, with a median reduction of 9.5\%. For a future Square Kilometre Array Observatory (SKAO)-like PTA, the predicted reduction reaches 36.4\%, with a median of 29.6\%, enabling significantly more precise measurements of the gravitational-wave background.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 该论文针对脉冲星计时阵列中Hellings-Downs曲线重构这一核心问题，提出联合利用全脉冲星对协方差的全体角最佳线性无偏估计方法，在公开NANOGrav 15年数据上报告了最高12.9%的误差改善，并预测SKAO类阵列可达36.4%。方法统计动机明确、结果量化、与PTA引力波背景检测直接相关，值得点击阅读。
decision.title_zh: Hellings-Downs 曲线的最优全角度重构
decision.abstract_zh: 脉冲星计时阵列（PTAs）通过不同脉冲星计时残差之间的空间相关性探测纳赫兹引力波。对于广义相对论中各向同性、非偏振的随机背景，系综平均相关性遵循 Hellings--Downs（HD）曲线；测量这一角度图样可检验信号的引力波起源。标准的分箱逐箱重构在每个角度分箱内分别优化权重。我们利用完整的脉冲星对协方差联合重构该曲线，在每个分箱中保留一个自由幅度。由此得到的全角度最佳线性无偏估计器最小化每个分箱值以及分箱任意线性组合的方差。应用于公开的 NANOGrav 15 年数据产品，我们的方法将分箱标准差最多降低 12.9\%，中位降低 9.5\%。对于未来类似平方公里阵列天文台（SKAO）的 PTA，预测降幅达到 36.4\%，中位为 29.6\%，从而能够显著更精确地测量引力波背景。
